name: Haiyoku no Rhodopis
source:
Beasts, fairies, and winged people---
Various non-human entities live in the city of Langria.
Ash the wizard owns a magic store,
and makes various interesting interactions in this city.

Running into a murderous fairy.
Ties between families been torn apart.
The dark intentions of the Kredal family---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE247600.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
野兽、妖精与翼人——
各种非人类存在生活在兰格里亚城。
巫师阿什经营一家魔法商店，在城中展开各种有趣互动。

他撞见了杀人妖精。
家族之间的羁绊被撕裂。
克雷达尔家族的黑暗意图……
